event_summary: A woman jogs away from the camera along a paved path beside a calm water body.
raw_event_description: At the start, the woman is already jogging on the paved riverside path near the left side of the frame. She continues moving farther away along the path, with alternating leg steps and arm swings. Her hair repeatedly swings outward and settles as she runs. As she gets farther from the camera, more of the long path, grassy slope, and water surface remain visible, while her body becomes smaller in the frame. A faint reflection of her lower body and shoes appears on wet sections of the pavement during the later part of the clip.

reasons: The runner is already in motion at the first visible frame.
The runner is close to the left edge of the frame, with part of the body near the frame boundary.
The path, water body, and grassy bank are visible.
